**Felix C. Holst** is a British designer who worked with Mattel's Hot Wheels division from 2004 to 2015 as the vice president of the creative division. A native of Newcastle upon Tyne, Holst came to the United States some time after graduation and joined Mattel. He left Mattel in 2015 to found Hackrod Inc., a company specializing in vehicle design, which appears to have since closed. He is currently self-employed and is the founder of Holst Automotive; on the side, he plays the bass guitar with a band called The Kustom Built and is a painter.
